items: [Android 16 System]This 10.1 inch tablet is equipped with 2026 latest Android 16 system, delivering an enhanced user experience. Built-in AI Gemini helps you quickly generate text content, boosting productivity; battery optimization prevents overcharging and extends battery life; split-screen functionality allows you to use two apps on one screen without frequently switching between them.

[10.1 Inch HD Display]This tablet features a 10.1 inch 1280*800 HD screen, delivering lifelike colors and sharp details. Even more thoughtfully, it has a built-in eye protection mode and dark mode, which can intelligently sense ambient light and automatically adjust brightness and color temperature, make every glance as comfortable as ever. 5+13MP dual camera,capture the beauty before your eyes and the scenery in the distance in the palm of your hand.

[Powerful Performance]This 10 inch tablet is equipped with an MTK6769 Octa-Core processor and 12GB RAM, Powerful performance ensures a consistently smooth system experience, allowing for effortless switching between multiple applications even when running simultaneously, with 64GB internal storage, Enough to hold your work documents, personal photos, and audio-visual entertainment. Storage is expandable up to 512GB(not included), so you can keep adding more content without worrying about running out of space.

[Long Lasting Battery Life]This latest Android tablet is equipped with a 7000mAh ultra large capacity battery, Unlike standard tablets that require daily charging, this powerhouse easily provides 10+ hours of mixed usage—perfect for binge-watching, work marathons, or cross-country flights. The Type-C interface allows for universal compatibility with a single cable, making your desktop cleaner and your life simpler and more efficient.

[Efficient and Portable]This Octa-Core tablet transforms instantly into a full workstation with included keyboard and mouse. Whether you're a professional or a student, you can easily handle document processing, creative projects, and entertainment needs, achieving desktop-like efficiency. Bluetooth 5.0 and 5G/2.4GHz dual bands WiFi ensures fast and stable connectivity whether you're at home, in a busy cafe, or on the go.

[Holiday Gifts]This Android 16 tablet isn't just a gift; it's a passport to endless entertainment and seamless connection, wrapped up in one stunning package. Whether it's for your tech-savvy best friend, your parents who love to stay in touch, or the little one with a big imagination, this tablet is the perfect way to spread holiday cheer.

[After Sales Service]MEIZE tablet computer professional team, focusing on customer service for more than ten years, adhering to the principle of customer first, with professional experience and excellent service, if you receive any problem products, please tell us anytime.
